scope: Native original-model initialization followed by eight supplied parameter-update/scale frames per instance. Original complete state matches at construction and after every stage; ordered update/morph/copy boundaries and independent parameter/event/scale data checks.
limitations: All eight appearance types, both FPU banks, with and without source accessories; supplied task/entity/heap and frame inputs. Natural task creation and scheduling are not recovered here.
No draw callback, visible pixels, platform renderer, fixed/high-FPS timing or playable-game claim. Existing complete-initializer and morph/copy sources remain unchanged.
